summary: Manual review of Fig. 1B and Fig. 1D confirmed ASCL1 as a core PNEC annotation marker in both snATAC-seq chromatin accessibility and snRNA-seq expression. SLC6A20 remains excluded as an AT2 marker.

markers.source_locator: Results: 'Fine-mapping risk variants for COVID-19 respiratory failure at the 3p21.31 locus...' section, para. 2; Fig. 5D legend
markers.source_context: SLC6A20, which encodes a proline transporter, was expressed predominantly in AT2 cells and had low expression in other cell types (Figure 5D). Figure 5D legend: 'Expression of SLC6A20 across lung cell types, where each dot represents a nucleus. The highest expression observed was in AT2 cells.'
markers.reason: 细胞类型 AT2 不属于 target_cell_scope（L4:Pulmonary neuroendocrine cell），且证据类型仅为 cluster_enriched，不构成正式 Marker。

markers.source_context: ASCL1 shows strong PNEC-specific chromatin accessibility in snATAC-seq and expression in snRNA-seq and is used for cluster annotation.
markers.reason: 人工复核 Fig. 1B/1D 确认 ASCL1 在 PNEC 中同时具有特异染色质开放性和表达，是核心 annotation marker。

issues.description: 现有候选 SLC6A20 为 AT2 细胞，不属于目标细胞范围 L4:Pulmonary neuroendocrine cell，应排除。
人工复核 Fig. 1B/1D 后确认 ASCL1 为 PNEC 核心 annotation marker。

task.paper_title: Single-cell multiomic profiling of human lungs reveals cell-type-specific and age-dynamic control of SARS-CoV2 host genes.
